dataset.name: Ordinex seed regulatory dataset
dataset.coverage: SMALL SEED SET: 5 EU GDPR articles, 3 India DPDP Act 2023 sections, 3 US HIPAA provisions. This is NOT a complete or live regulatory feed.
dataset.verificationStatus: PARTIAL - HIPAA entries were checked against the official eCFR on 2026-10-29 (existence, heading, key operative elements only); GDPR and DPDP entries are UNVERIFIED (official sources could not be retrieved). All 'obligation' fields are paraphrases, not official wording. Not legal advice; not reviewed by a lawyer.
dataset.updateMechanism: Edit regdata/regulations.json using the same schema and restart the server. Set lastVerified per regulation only after checking the official text.
dataset.verificationNotes: lastVerified stays null until EVERY regulation is verified. See each regulation's sourceCheck.

provisions.title: Storage limitation
provisions.obligation: Personal data must be kept in a form permitting identification for no longer than necessary for the purposes of processing.
verification: Retention schedule exists and covers each data category
Deletion job or procedure evidenced in logs

provisions.title: Records of processing activities
provisions.obligation: Controllers must maintain a record of processing activities including purposes, categories of data subjects and data, recipients, transfers, retention periods and a general description of security measures.

provisions.title: Security of processing
provisions.obligation: Controllers and processors must implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk, such as pseudonymisation and encryption, ongoing confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience, ability to restore availability after an incident, and regular testing of effectiveness.
verification: Encryption at rest and in transit evidenced
Access control review and security testing records exist

provisions.title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority
provisions.obligation: A controller must notify the competent supervisory authority of a personal data breach without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after becoming aware of it, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to individuals. Processors must notify the controller without undue delay.
verification: Breach response procedure names the 72-hour notification step

provisions.title: Data protection impact assessment
provisions.obligation: Where processing is likely to result in a high risk to individuals (including large-scale processing of special categories of data), the controller must carry out an assessment of the impact of the envisaged processing before the processing.
verification: DPIA completed and signed off for each high-risk processing activity

provisions.title: Consent
provisions.obligation: Consent of the Data Principal must be free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous with a clear affirmative action, limited to the specified purpose, and must be capable of being withdrawn as easily as it was given.
verification: Consent notice reviewed for purpose and withdrawal mechanism

provisions.title: Reasonable security safeguards
provisions.obligation: A Data Fiduciary must protect personal data in its possession or under its control by taking reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breach.
verification: Security controls inventory mapped to personal-data systems

provisions.title: Intimation of personal data breach
provisions.obligation: In the event of a personal data breach, the Data Fiduciary must give the Data Protection Board and each affected Data Principal intimation of the breach in the form and manner prescribed.
provisions.statutoryDeadline: Form and manner prescribed by Rules - confirm in the current DPDP Rules
verification: Breach procedure covers both Board and data principal notification

regulations.name: HIPAA Security Rule and Breach Notification Rule (45 CFR Parts 160, 164)
regulations.authority: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services

provisions.title: Security risk analysis
provisions.obligation: A covered entity or business associate must conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity and availability of electronic protected health information.
verification: Dated risk analysis covering all systems holding ePHI

provisions.title: Encryption and decryption (addressable)
provisions.obligation: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information. This specification is addressable: it must be implemented if reasonable and appropriate, otherwise the reason and an equivalent alternative must be documented.
verification: Encryption evidenced for ePHI at rest, or a documented addressable-specification decision

provisions.title: Breach notification to individuals
provisions.obligation: A covered entity must notify each affected individual following discovery of a breach of unsecured protected health information, without unreasonable delay and in no case later than 60 calendar days after discovery.
verification: Breach notification procedure states the 60-day outer limit

sourceCheck.method: Fetched the official eCFR API (ecfr.gov versioner, Title 45 Part 164) and read the cited sections
sourceCheck.officialTextVersion: eCFR as of 2025-01-01 (later amendments not checked)
sourceCheck.scope: Section existence and headings; 60-calendar-day outer limit (164.404(b)); encryption specification labelled Addressable (164.312(a)(2)(iv)); risk analysis labelled Required with the opening words of 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A). The obligation wording itself is a paraphrase.
sourceCheck.reuseStatus: US federal government work (believed public domain); not independently verified
